title: (OLD FIX) Importing JSON in ESM: add assert { type: 'json' }

problem.symptom: TypeError: Module "./data.json" needs an import attribute of "type: json"
problem.description: ESM refuses to import JSON without declaring its type. This capsule records the fix that was common in 2022-2023 (import assertions).

applicability.notes: Claim as originally written; kept to show how evidence detects regressions.

files.main.mjs:
import data from "./data.json" assert { type: "json" };
console.log(data.name);

limitations.proves: The JSON module loads with this runtime.
limitations.does_not_prove: Anything about newer Node versions; see superseding capsule.
